Crispy tortilla cones filled with juicy spiced beef and topped with melted mozzarella 🧀🔥 The perfect crunchy snack or quick dinner that everyone will love. One bite and you’re hooked 🤤 Crispy Beef Cones (12 cones) Ingredients For the cones:  • 6 tortillas (25–30 cm / 10–12 inches)  • Toothpicks For the topping:  • Mozzarella cheese, 100 g  • Chopped parsley, 1 tsp For the beef mixture:  • Ground beef, 400 g(0.8lb)   • 1 yellow onion, finely chopped  • Garlic, 4 cloves, minced  • Red bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Green bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Tomato paste, 1 big tbsp   • Soy milk, 100 ml (~ ½ cup) Seasoning:  • Paprika, 1 tbsp  • Chili powder, 1 tsp  • Turmeric, 1 tsp  • Garlic powder, 1 tsp  • Black pepper, 1 tsp  • Garam masala, 1 tsp  • Salt, ½ tsp Instructions 1.⁠ ⁠Prepare the beef mixture:  • Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté until soft.  • Add the minced garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.  • Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.  • Stir in tomato paste, soy milk, diced bell peppers, and all seasonings. Cook until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. 2.⁠ ⁠Prepare the cones:  • Cut tortillas in half. Roll each half into a cone shape and secure the edge with a toothpick. Baking Method:  1. Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).  2. Place cones on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Lightly spray with cooking spray.  3. Bake for 10–12 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Return to oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. Air Fryer Method:   1. Preheat air fryer to 180°C (356°F).  2. Lightly spray cones with cooking spray and place them in the air fryer basket. Make sure they don’t touch each other.  3. Air fry for 6–8 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Carefully fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Air fry again for 3–4 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. #crispybeef #quickrecipes #easyrecipes #lazydinner #beefcones

If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

videos.caption: Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Garnish with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, or red pepper flakes if desired. #easyrecipe  #pasta #chicken #familydinner #onepot

Blueberry pull apart bread 🫐✨ Ingredients  Bread - 435g bread flour (3 cups + 2 tbsp) - 68g granulated sugar (1/3 cup) - 185g whole milk (3/4 cup) - 60g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 7g active dry yeast (2 1/4 tsp) - 2 large eggs - 1/2 tsp salt Blueberry compote - 300g blueberries (about 2 cups) - 95g granulated sugar (10 tbsp + 2 tsp) - 1 tbsp lemon juice  - 12g cornstarch (cornstarch slurry) - 2 tbsp water (cornstarch slurry) Icing (didn’t measure) - Confectioners sugar - Melted butter - Whole milk - Splash of vanilla extract  - Splash of lemon extract  Instructions  Filling - In a medium sauce pan on medium heat combine blueberries, sugar, and lemon juice. Stir until well combined and cook until bubbling. - Add cornstarch slurry and stir constantly until very thick.  - Transfer into a heat safe bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and cool for 10 minutes on the counter then refrigerate for 30-40 minutes. Bread - In a bowl, combine warm milk and 1 tbsp sugar. Sprinkle yeast over the top, stir lightly, and let sit 5–10 minutes until foamy. - Add eggs, 1/3 sugar, and mix again until well combined. - Add flour to mixture. Mix until a rough dough forms. - Begin kneading. Once the dough starts to come together, gradually add the softened butter (1 tbsp at a time), kneading until fully incorporated before adding more. - Continue kneading 8–10 minutes by hand or 5–6 minutes in a stand mixer, until smooth, elastic, and slightly tacky. - Transfer dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and let rise 1–1½ hours, or until doubled in size. - Punch down dough and roll into a rectangle about 12x18 inches - Spread filling evenly across the surface - Cut into strips, then stack and cut again to fit upright into a greased loaf pan (1/2 pound loaf pan) - Cover loosely and let rise 30–40 minutes, until puffy. - Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 35–40 minutes, tenting with foil if the top browns too quickly. - Top with icing and serve!  • • • #recipes #baking #springrecipes #bakingrecipe #recipeideas

Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles These Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles are an easy, flavorful dinner. This is a quick dinner the whole family will love! Thank you for the inspo @britscookin 🫶 Ingredients 1 lb ground beef 4 packages ramen noodles, seasoning packets discarded (about 10–12 oz) Salt and black pepper, to taste 8 oz mushrooms, sliced 1 head broccoli, cut into florets 1/3 cup water, for steaming broccoli Mongolian Sauce 1/2 cup soy sauce 1/2 cup chicken broth 1/3 cup brown sugar 2 tbsp hoisin sauce 1 tbsp minced garlic 1 tsp fresh ginger paste  1 tsp sesame oil 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, optional Cornstarch Slurry 1 tbsp cornstarch 2 tbsp cold water Directions 1. Add the ground beef to a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Drain any excess grease if needed. 2. Add the mushrooms and broccoli into the skillet.  3. Add 1/3 of water to the skillet and cover to let the broccoli steam for a few minutes.  4. While the broccoli is steaming, cook the ramen noodles according to the package directions, leaving out the seasoning packets. Drain and set aside. 5. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, chicken broth, brown sugar, hoisin sauce, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes. 6. Pour the Mongolian sauce over the beef, mushrooms, and broccoli. Stir until everything is well combined. 7. Whisk together the cornstarch and cold water. Pour the slurry into the skillet and let everything simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. 8. Add the cooked ramen noodles and toss until everything is coated in the sauce. #EasyRecipe #DinnerIdeas #quickrecipes #onepotmeals #easydinner

Because this is a labor of love. 🤎🔥 For Black History Month, I’m bringing back Burnt Sugar Cake, a historic Black Southern celebration cake that slowly faded when box mixes took over. Burnt Sugar Cake Burnt Sugar Syrup • 1 cup granulated sugar (200 g) • 1 cup boiling water (240 ml) Melt sugar over medium heat until deep amber (do not stir, swirl pan). Carefully add boiling water, stir smooth, simmer 3–5 min. Cool. Reserve ½ cup for cake + ½ cup for frosting. Cake • 1 cup butter, softened (227 g) • 2 cups sugar (400 g) • 4 eggs • 3 cups cake flour (360 g) • 1 tbsp baking powder (14 g) • ½ tsp salt • 1 cup whole milk (240 ml) • ½ cup burnt sugar syrup • 2 tsp vanilla Heat oven to 350°F / 175°C. Grease three 8-inch pans. Cream butter + sugar 3–5 min. Add eggs one at a time. Whisk dry ingredients. Alternate dry ingredients + milk into batter. Mix in burnt sugar syrup + vanilla. Bake 25–30 min. Cool completely. Traditional Burnt Sugar Frosting (work fast!) • ½ cup butter (113 g) • 1 cup brown sugar (200 g) • ½ cup burnt sugar syrup • ¼ cup evaporated milk (60 ml) • 3–4 cups powdered sugar (360–480 g) • pinch salt + 1 tsp vanilla Boil butter, brown sugar, syrup & milk 2 minutes. Cool until warm, then beat in powdered sugar, salt & vanilla. Frost cake quickly before it sets. Optional Brown Sugar Penuche Frosting (creamier outside) • 1½ cups butter, divided (340 g) • 1½ cups brown sugar (300 g) • ½ cup heavy cream (120 ml) • 1 tsp salt • 4½ cups powdered sugar (540 g) Melt ¾ cup butter. Boil brown sugar + cream + salt. Beat into melted butter with powdered sugar. Add remaining butter 1 tbsp at a time. Rest 10–30 min until spreadable. Assemble Fill and frost cake with traditional burnt sugar frosting. Optional: cover outside with penuche frosting. Finish with rustic swoops and swirls. #BlackHistory #TikTokLearn#BlackHistoryBlackFoodHistory#TikTokLearningCampaigngeRecipes

Let me know in the comments 👍🏿 Ingredients:  Yukon Gold Potatoes  Salt Baking Soda- 1tsp Vegetable Oil (great with beef tallow too) Garlic and Herb Butter:  Fresh Thyme- 1tbsp Fresh Rosemary- 1tbsp  Fresh Parsley- 1tbsp  Garlic- 4 cloves chopped or minced Salt- 1tbsp Butter- 4tbsp Shredded Parmesan Cheese to garnish Method: Peel and cut Yukon Golds into big chunks (2in+ so they don’t break down when boiling) Add to pot with water, salt and 1 tsp baking soda (baking soda helps creates the rough exterior texture). Marry Me Chicken Tortellini is an easy and delicious dinner recipe the whole family loves!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts, sliced into cubes  1/2 cup of flour  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder  2 TBSP olive oil 2 TBSP butter 2 TBSP of minced garlic 1 cup of chicken broth 1 cup of heavy cream 1 cup of Parmesan cheese 1 tsp of red pepper flakes  1/2 tsp each of oregano and thyme  1/3 cup of chopped sun dried tomatoes 19 oz bag of frozen tortellini  INSTRUCTIONS Mix together flour, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Dredge chicken breasts into the flour/seasoning mixture.   In a skillet heat olive oil and butter on medium heat. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes on each side until golden brown and it reaches 165 degrees.  Take the chicken out of the skillet and put aside.  Add minced garlic, sun dried tomatoes, and chicken broth to the skillet. Lower heat and add heavy cream and Parmesan cheese. Stir well.  Add the red pepper flakes, oregano, and thyme. Stir together well and let simmer until it starts to slightly thicken (this could take at least five minutes).  Add one bag of frozen tortellini, cover, and let cook for a few minutes. The tortellini will also help thicken the sauce. Once tortellini is tender add chicken back to the skillet and serve. Enjoy! *This is a little bit spicy with 1 tsp of red pepper flakes, for less heat use 1/4 tsp!  #dinner #chicken #recipes

Recipe Name Smash Burger Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb ground beef 2. 6 small flour tortillas 3. 6 slices cheddar cheese 4. 2 cups shredded lettuce 5. 1/2 cup diced onion 6. 1/2 cup diced tomatoes 7. 1 tbsp olive oil 8. 1 tsp salt 9. 1/2 tsp black pepper 10. 1 tsp garlic powder 11. 1 tsp smoked paprika 12. 1/2 cup mayonnaise 13. 2 tbsp ketchup 14. 1 tbsp yellow mustard 15. 1 tbsp finely chopped pickles 16. 1 tsp pickle juice 17. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 18. 1/4 tsp black pepper Recipe 1. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, chopped pickles, pickle juice, garlic powder, and black pepper. 2. Stir the sauce until smooth, then refrigerate while preparing the tacos. 3. Divide the ground beef into 6 equal portions. 4. Season the beef lightly with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. 5. Place one tortilla on a hot skillet or griddle. 6. Press one portion of ground beef directly onto the tortilla, spreading it into a thin, even layer almost to the edges. 7. Cook beef-side down for 2–3 minutes until deeply browned and crispy. 8. Flip the tortilla and beef together, then immediately place a slice of cheddar cheese on top. 9. Cook for another 1–2 minutes until the tortilla is crisp and the cheese is melted. 10. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and beef. 11. Top each taco with shredded lettuce, diced onion, and diced tomatoes. 12. Drizzle generously with the creamy burger sauce. 13. Fold the tacos slightly and serve immediately while the beef is hot and the cheese is melted. 14. Add extra pickles or sauce if desired for an even more classic burger flavor.
